scripts.validate:html-output: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && node scripts/validate-html-output.mjs
scripts.validate:js-budget: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && node scripts/validate-js-budget.mjs
scripts.validate:render-flow: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && node scripts/validate-render-flow.mjs
scripts.validate:fast: npm run validate:operational-telemetry && npm run validate:astro-anti-patterns && npm run validate:css-policy && npm run validate:design-system && npm run validate:social-assets && npm run validate:content-source-boundary && npm run validate:portfolio-content && npm run validate:page-surfaces && npm run validate:no-prototype-slop
scripts.validate:source: npm run validate:release-boundary && npm run validate:fast && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && npm run test:smoke && node scripts/validate-html-output.mjs
scripts.validate:rendered: npm run validate:source && node scripts/validate-js-budget.mjs && node scripts/validate-render-flow.mjs && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:visual
scripts.validate:site: npm run validate:rendered && npm run lhci
scripts.test:smoke: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run build && node scripts/smoke-pages.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:visual: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/visual
scripts.test:visual:update: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/visual --update-snapshots
scripts.test:a11y: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/a11y
scripts.test:policy-style: grep -q '^test-results/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^playwright-report/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^\.playwright-cache/$' .gitignore && grep -q '^\.playwright-tmp/$' .gitignore && npm run validate:astro-anti-patterns || (echo 'Error: Required Playwright artifact paths missing from .gitignore or Astro anti-pattern validation failed' && exit 1)
scripts.screenshots:site: mkdir -p .playwright-tmp && TMPDIR=$PWD/.playwright-tmp PWTEST_CACHE_DIR=.playwright-cache playwright test tests/screenshots
